metadata.requirement_name: Name & Complete Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 6(1)(a): Every package shall bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer or importer.
metadata.explanation: Manufacturer or packer name and complete physical address with PIN code is mandatory on all principal display panels.

document: Name & Complete Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Importer. Every package shall bear the name and complete physical address of the manufacturer or packer or importer, including City, State, and Postal PIN code on the Principal Display Panel. Citation: Rule 6(1)(a): Every package shall bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer or importer.

metadata.requirement_name: Common or Generic Name of the Commodity
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 6(1)(b): The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package shall be clearly stated.
metadata.explanation: The package must explicitly state the generic or trade name so consumers clearly recognize the commodity.

document: Common or Generic Name of the Commodity. The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package shall be clearly stated prominently on the principal display panel so consumers readily identify what the product is. Citation: Rule 6(1)(b): The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package shall be clearly stated.

metadata.requirement_name: Net Quantity in Standard Units (Weight / Measure)
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 6(1)(c): The net quantity, in terms of standard unit of weight or measure, shall be declared.
metadata.explanation: Net quantity must be declared using standard metric units without qualifying phrases.

document: Net Quantity in Standard Units (Weight / Measure). Net quantity must be declared in standard legal metric units (g, kg, ml, l, mg, m, cm) without misleading qualifying words such as "approximate", "jumbo", or "pure". For solid commodities by weight, liquids by volume. Citation: Rule 6(1)(c): The net quantity, in terms of standard unit of weight or measure, shall be declared.

metadata.requirement_name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 6(1)(d): The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed or imported shall be mentioned.
metadata.explanation: Date of manufacturing/packing is required for legal validity and freshness verification.

document: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import. The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed, or imported must be declared in clear numerical or alphabetical format (e.g., MM/YYYY, 01/2026, or Jan 2026). Provisos exempt bidis and LPG cylinders. Citation: Rule 6(1)(d): The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or packed or imported shall be mentioned.

metadata.requirement_name: MRP with "Inclusive of all taxes" Mandatory Phrase
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 6(1)(e) & Rule 2(m): The maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes.
metadata.explanation: The retail price must be formatted with the mandatory tax disclaimer phrase. Surcharges above MRP constitute a punishable offense under Section 36.

document: MRP with "Inclusive of all taxes" Mandatory Phrase. The retail sale price of the package must be expressed in the mandatory statutory format: "Maximum Retail Price" or "MRP Rs. XX.XX (inclusive of all taxes)" or "MRP Rs. XX.XX incl. of all taxes". No retailer may charge above MRP or charge extra tax on top of MRP. Citation: Rule 6(1)(e) & Rule 2(m): The maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes.

metadata.requirement_name: Mandatory Consumer Care Contact Details (Phone, Email, Address)
metadata.explanation: Every package must bear name, physical address, telephone number, and e-mail address of the person or office that can be contacted by consumers in case of consumer complaints and grievances.

document: Mandatory Consumer Care Contact Details (Phone, Email, Address). Every package must bear name, physical address, telephone number, and e-mail address of the person or office that can be contacted by consumers in case of consumer complaints and grievances. Citation: Rule 6(2)

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology Rules 2011, Rule 7(2) Table I
metadata.requirement_name: Minimum Numeral & Letter Height on Principal Display Panel
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 7(2) Table I: Minimum height of numerals and letters based on net quantity.
metadata.explanation: Declared font and numeral sizes must strictly adhere to the millimeter thresholds in Table I based on package net quantity.

document: Minimum Numeral & Letter Height on Principal Display Panel. Minimum numeral and letter height in declarations under Table I: Up to 200g or 200ml requires minimum 2.0 mm height; Exceeding 200g up to 1kg (or 200ml to 1L) requires minimum 4.0 mm height; Exceeding 1kg (or 1L) requires minimum 6.0 mm height. For blown, formed, molded or perforated letters on metal/glass/plastic, minimum height is 2.0 mm, 4.0 mm, and 6.0 mm respectively. Citation: Rule 7(2) Table I: Minimum height of numerals and letters based on net quantity.

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology Rules 2011, Rule 6(10) Amendment & E-Commerce Rules
metadata.requirement_name: Country of Origin and E-Commerce Marketplace Disclosures
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 6(10): Mandatory declaration of country of origin for imported goods and digital commerce.
metadata.explanation: Country of origin is mandatory on packaging and all digital e-commerce product detail pages.

document: Country of Origin and E-Commerce Marketplace Disclosures. For imported goods and products listed on digital e-commerce marketplaces, the country of origin must be prominently stated. Marketplaces must display manufacturer name, country of origin, net quantity, expiry/best before date, and MRP inclusive of taxes on the product digital display page. Citation: Rule 6(10): Mandatory declaration of country of origin for imported goods and digital commerce.

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology Rules 2011, Rule 32 & Section 36/53 Legal Metrology Act 2009
metadata.requirement_name: Compounding Fine Schedule and Prosecution Procedure
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 32 Compounding Schedule & Section 36(1) of the Act
metadata.explanation: First-time packaging offenses are compounded at ₹2,000 per violation; repeated offenses mandate prosecution.

document: Compounding Fine Schedule and Prosecution Procedure. Under Rule 32, offenses under Section 36(1) for packaging non-compliance (missing MRP, missing manufacturer address, non-compliant numeral height) can be compounded for ₹2,000 for the first offense. Subsequent offenses within three years cannot be compounded and lead to court prosecution with fines up to ₹50,000 or imprisonment up to one year. Citation: Rule 32 Compounding Schedule & Section 36(1) of the Act

metadata.requirement_name: Statutory Exemptions from Package Commodities Rules
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 3 & Rule 26: Commodities exempt from the provisions of Chapter II.
metadata.explanation: Packages under 10g/10ml and bulk packages for industrial consumers with clear non-retail markings are exempt from standard retail declarations.

document: Statutory Exemptions from Package Commodities Rules. The 2011 Rules do not apply to: packages containing quantities of 10g or 10ml or less; packages containing agricultural produce exceeding 50kg; packages meant specifically for export; packages containing fast food items packed by restaurants or hotels; and industrial consumers or institutional consumers buying packages directly for manufacturing or internal consumption with "not for retail sale" declaration. Citation: Rule 3 & Rule 26: Commodities exempt from the provisions of Chapter II.

metadata.requirement_name: Short Title and Commencement
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 1: Short title and Commencement, GSR 202(E)
metadata.explanation: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 came into force on 1st April 2011 under powers conferred by section 52(1) read with clauses (j) and (q) of section 52(2) of the Legal Metrology Act 2009 (1 of 2010).

document: Short Title and Commencement. The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 came into force on 1st April 2011 under powers conferred by section 52(1) read with clauses (j) and (q) of section 52(2) of the Legal Metrology Act 2009 (1 of 2010). Citation: Rule 1: Short title and Commencement, GSR 202(E)

metadata.requirement_name: Definitions of Dealer, Manufacturer, and Packer
metadata.explanation: Definitions under Rule 2: "Dealer" means a person or firm carrying on the business of buying, selling, supplying or distributing packaged commodities. "Manufacturer" means a person or firm producing, making, or manufacturing such commodity or affixing marks claiming the commodity. "Packer" means a person or firm pre-packing any commodity in bottles, tins, wrappers or units suitable for wholesale or retail sale.

document: Definitions of Dealer, Manufacturer, and Packer. Definitions under Rule 2: "Dealer" means a person or firm carrying on the business of buying, selling, supplying or distributing packaged commodities. "Manufacturer" means a person or firm producing, making, or manufacturing such commodity or affixing marks claiming the commodity. "Packer" means a person or firm pre-packing any commodity in bottles, tins, wrappers or units suitable for wholesale or retail sale. Citation: Rule 2(b), Rule 2(d), Rule 2(g)

metadata.requirement_name: Definitions of Maximum Permissible Error, Net Quantity, Principal Display Panel
metadata.explanation: "Maximum permissible error" (MPE) in relation to quantity in an individual package means error in deficiency not exceeding limits in First Schedule. "Net quantity" means quantity by weight, measure or number excluding packaging or wrapper. "Principal display panel" (PDP) means total surface area of package where information required under these rules is grouped together at one place.

document: Definitions of Maximum Permissible Error, Net Quantity, Principal Display Panel. "Maximum permissible error" (MPE) in relation to quantity in an individual package means error in deficiency not exceeding limits in First Schedule. "Net quantity" means quantity by weight, measure or number excluding packaging or wrapper. "Principal display panel" (PDP) means total surface area of package where information required under these rules is grouped together at one place. Citation: Rule 2(e), Rule 2(f), Rule 2(h)

metadata.requirement_name: Definitions of Retail Package, Retail Sale Price (MRP), Wholesale Package
metadata.explanation: "Retail package" means packages intended for retail sale to ultimate consumer (excluding industrial or institutional consumers). "Retail sale price" means maximum price printed as "Maximum or Max. retail price Rs. ... inclusive of all taxes" or "MRP Rs. ... incl. of all taxes" with statutory rounding rules. "Wholesale package" contains retail packages intended for sale to intermediaries.

document: Definitions of Retail Package, Retail Sale Price (MRP), Wholesale Package. "Retail package" means packages intended for retail sale to ultimate consumer (excluding industrial or institutional consumers). "Retail sale price" means maximum price printed as "Maximum or Max. retail price Rs. ... inclusive of all taxes" or "MRP Rs. ... incl. of all taxes" with statutory rounding rules. "Wholesale package" contains retail packages intended for sale to intermediaries. Citation: Rule 2(k), Rule 2(m), Rule 2(r)

metadata.requirement_name: Exemption for Packages Exceeding 25kg/25L and Industrial/Institutional Consumers
metadata.explanation: Chapter II provisions do not apply to: (a) packages containing quantity more than 25 kg or 25 litre, excluding cement and fertilizer sold in bags up to 50 kg; (b) packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers (direct use by industry) or institutional consumers (Transportation, Airways, Railways, Hotels, Hospitals buying directly from manufacturer).

document: Exemption for Packages Exceeding 25kg/25L and Industrial/Institutional Consumers. Chapter II provisions do not apply to: (a) packages containing quantity more than 25 kg or 25 litre, excluding cement and fertilizer sold in bags up to 50 kg; (b) packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers (direct use by industry) or institutional consumers (Transportation, Airways, Railways, Hotels, Hospitals buying directly from manufacturer). Citation: Rule 3(a), Rule 3(b) & Explanations

metadata.requirement_name: Prohibition on Pre-packing without Mandatory Declarations
metadata.legal_citation: Rule 4: Regulation for pre-packing and sale etc.
metadata.explanation: No person shall pre-pack, cause, or permit to be pre-packed any commodity for sale, distribution or delivery unless the package bears mandatory declarations. Packages inside manufacturer premises without price declaration are not violations until leaving premises for destination.

document: Prohibition on Pre-packing without Mandatory Declarations. No person shall pre-pack, cause, or permit to be pre-packed any commodity for sale, distribution or delivery unless the package bears mandatory declarations. Packages inside manufacturer premises without price declaration are not violations until leaving premises for destination. Citation: Rule 4: Regulation for pre-packing and sale etc.

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 5 & Second Schedule
metadata.requirement_name: Mandatory Standard Package Quantities (Second Schedule Commodities)
metadata.explanation: Commodities specified in Second Schedule must be packed for sale only in recommended standard quantities. Includes baby food, biscuits (25g, 50g, 75g, 100g...), bread (100g multiples), butter, cereals/pulses (100g, 200g, 500g, 1kg, 2kg, 5kg), coffee, tea, edible oils (50g, 100g, 200g, 500g, 1kg, 2kg, 5kg), milk powder, rice/flour/atta, salt, soaps, aerated drinks, mineral water, cement, and paints.

document: Mandatory Standard Package Quantities (Second Schedule Commodities). Commodities specified in Second Schedule must be packed for sale only in recommended standard quantities. Includes baby food, biscuits (25g, 50g, 75g, 100g...), bread (100g multiples), butter, cereals/pulses (100g, 200g, 500g, 1kg, 2kg, 5kg), coffee, tea, edible oils (50g, 100g, 200g, 500g, 1kg, 2kg, 5kg), milk powder, rice/flour/atta, salt, soaps, aerated drinks, mineral water, cement, and paints. Citation: Rule 5 & Second Schedule

metadata.requirement_name: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer, Packer, and Importer
metadata.explanation: Every package must bear the name and complete physical address of manufacturer, or manufacturer and packer, and for imported goods the importer. Brand owners acting as marketers are deemed manufacturers. Address without "manufactured by" is presumed to be manufacturer. Food articles defer to Prevention of Food Adulteration / FSSAI.

document: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer, Packer, and Importer. Every package must bear the name and complete physical address of manufacturer, or manufacturer and packer, and for imported goods the importer. Brand owners acting as marketers are deemed manufacturers. Address without "manufactured by" is presumed to be manufacturer. Food articles defer to Prevention of Food Adulteration / FSSAI. Citation: Rule 6(1)(a) & Explanations I, II, III

metadata.requirement_name: Generic Name, Net Quantity in Standard Units, and Manufacturing/Packing Date
metadata.explanation: Mandatory declarations on every package: (b) Common or generic name of commodity; (c) Net quantity in standard units of weight, measure or number; (d) Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import. Provisos exempt bidis, incense sticks, and domestic LPG cylinders (14.2kg or 5kg) from date marking.

document: Generic Name, Net Quantity in Standard Units, and Manufacturing/Packing Date. Mandatory declarations on every package: (b) Common or generic name of commodity; (c) Net quantity in standard units of weight, measure or number; (d) Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import. Provisos exempt bidis, incense sticks, and domestic LPG cylinders (14.2kg or 5kg) from date marking. Citation: Rule 6(1)(b), 6(1)(c), 6(1)(d)

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6(1)(e) & Rule 2(m)
metadata.requirement_name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration and Tax Disclaimer
metadata.explanation: Retail sale price must be printed on package as "Maximum or Max. retail price Rs. ... inclusive of all taxes" or "MRP Rs. ... incl. of all taxes". No retailer may sell above MRP or charge extra tax. Rounding rule: fractions under 50 paise round down, above 50 paise to 95 paise round to 50 paise. Alcoholic beverages follow State Excise laws.

document: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration and Tax Disclaimer. Retail sale price must be printed on package as "Maximum or Max. retail price Rs. ... inclusive of all taxes" or "MRP Rs. ... incl. of all taxes". No retailer may sell above MRP or charge extra tax. Rounding rule: fractions under 50 paise round down, above 50 paise to 95 paise round to 50 paise. Alcoholic beverages follow State Excise laws. Citation: Rule 6(1)(e) & Rule 2(m)

metadata.requirement_name: Prohibition of Stickers Except for Lowering MRP
metadata.explanation: It is not permissible to affix individual stickers on packages to alter or make mandatory declarations. Exception: For reducing Maximum Retail Price (MRP), a sticker showing revised lower MRP (inclusive of all taxes) may be affixed provided it does not cover the original manufacturer MRP.

document: Prohibition of Stickers Except for Lowering MRP. It is not permissible to affix individual stickers on packages to alter or make mandatory declarations. Exception: For reducing Maximum Retail Price (MRP), a sticker showing revised lower MRP (inclusive of all taxes) may be affixed provided it does not cover the original manufacturer MRP. Citation: Rule 6(3) & Proviso, Rule 6(4)

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6(10) & E-Commerce Amendments
metadata.requirement_name: Country of Origin and E-Commerce Marketplace Disclosures
metadata.explanation: Mandatory country of origin declaration on all imported packages and digital e-commerce listings. E-commerce platforms must display manufacturer name, address, country of origin, net quantity, best before/expiry date, MRP inclusive of taxes, and consumer care details on the digital product display page.

document: Country of Origin and E-Commerce Marketplace Disclosures. Mandatory country of origin declaration on all imported packages and digital e-commerce listings. E-commerce platforms must display manufacturer name, address, country of origin, net quantity, best before/expiry date, MRP inclusive of taxes, and consumer care details on the digital product display page. Citation: Rule 6(10) & Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 7(2) Table I
metadata.requirement_name: Minimum Numeral Height by Net Weight / Volume (Table I)
metadata.explanation: Table I - Minimum Numeral Height for declarations by weight or volume on Principal Display Panel: (1) Up to 200g / 200ml: 1.0 mm normal, 2.0 mm if blown/formed/molded/embossed/perforated on container; (2) Above 200g/ml up to 500g/ml: 2.0 mm normal, 4.0 mm blown/formed/embossed; (3) Above 500g/ml: 4.0 mm normal, 6.0 mm blown/formed/embossed. Height of letters minimum 1.0 mm normal, 2.0 mm blown/embossed. Letter width must be at least 1/3 of height.

document: Minimum Numeral Height by Net Weight / Volume (Table I). Table I - Minimum Numeral Height for declarations by weight or volume on Principal Display Panel: (1) Up to 200g / 200ml: 1.0 mm normal, 2.0 mm if blown/formed/molded/embossed/perforated on container; (2) Above 200g/ml up to 500g/ml: 2.0 mm normal, 4.0 mm blown/formed/embossed; (3) Above 500g/ml: 4.0 mm normal, 6.0 mm blown/formed/embossed. Height of letters minimum 1.0 mm normal, 2.0 mm blown/embossed. Letter width must be at least 1/3 of height. Citation: Rule 7(2) Table I

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 7(2) Table II
metadata.requirement_name: Minimum Numeral Height by Principal Display Panel Area (Table II)
metadata.explanation: Table II - Minimum Numeral Height for quantity in length, area, number or area of PDP: (1) PDP area up to 100 cm²: 1.0 mm normal, 2.0 mm embossed/blown; (2) Above 100 cm² up to 500 cm²: 2.0 mm normal, 4.0 mm embossed; (3) Above 500 cm² up to 2500 cm²: 4.0 mm normal, 6.0 mm embossed; (4) Above 2500 cm²: 6.0 mm normal, 6.0 mm embossed.

document: Minimum Numeral Height by Principal Display Panel Area (Table II). Table II - Minimum Numeral Height for quantity in length, area, number or area of PDP: (1) PDP area up to 100 cm²: 1.0 mm normal, 2.0 mm embossed/blown; (2) Above 100 cm² up to 500 cm²: 2.0 mm normal, 4.0 mm embossed; (3) Above 500 cm² up to 2500 cm²: 4.0 mm normal, 6.0 mm embossed; (4) Above 2500 cm²: 6.0 mm normal, 6.0 mm embossed. Citation: Rule 7(2) Table II

metadata.requirement_name: Clear Space Surrounding Quantity Declaration on PDP
metadata.explanation: All declarations must appear on the principal display panel. The area surrounding quantity declaration must be free from printed information: above and below by space equal to at least height of numeral, and left and right by space at least twice the height of numeral. For returnable soft drink bottles, MRP may appear on crown cap or bottle.

document: Clear Space Surrounding Quantity Declaration on PDP. All declarations must appear on the principal display panel. The area surrounding quantity declaration must be free from printed information: above and below by space equal to at least height of numeral, and left and right by space at least twice the height of numeral. For returnable soft drink bottles, MRP may appear on crown cap or bottle. Citation: Rule 8(1), Rule 8(2)

metadata.requirement_name: Contrast, Legibility, and Mandatory Language (Hindi / English)
metadata.explanation: Declarations must be prominent and legible. Numerals of retail sale price and net quantity must be in a colour conspicuously contrasting with background. Declarations must not be read through liquid. Outside wrapper must carry declarations unless transparent. Mandatory language: English or Hindi in Devanagari script (other languages permitted in addition).

document: Contrast, Legibility, and Mandatory Language (Hindi / English). Declarations must be prominent and legible. Numerals of retail sale price and net quantity must be in a colour conspicuously contrasting with background. Declarations must not be read through liquid. Outside wrapper must carry declarations unless transparent. Mandatory language: English or Hindi in Devanagari script (other languages permitted in addition). Citation: Rule 9(1), 9(2), 9(3), 9(4)

metadata.requirement_name: Requirement of Street Name, Factory Address, City, State, and PIN Code
metadata.explanation: Every package must bear name and complete address of manufacturer/packer/importer. "Complete address" means postal address of factory or street name, premises number, city, State, and Postal Index Number (PIN) Code so consumers can locate the premises. Shorter registered address permitted under Rule 28.

document: Requirement of Street Name, Factory Address, City, State, and PIN Code. Every package must bear name and complete address of manufacturer/packer/importer. "Complete address" means postal address of factory or street name, premises number, city, State, and Postal Index Number (PIN) Code so consumers can locate the premises. Shorter registered address permitted under Rule 28. Citation: Rule 10(1) & Explanation

metadata.requirement_name: Net Quantity Determination and Prohibition of Misleading Terms
metadata.explanation: Net quantity excludes wrappers/packaging. Declaration must not contain exaggerated or misleading words like "minimum", "not less than", "average", "about", or "approximately". Mass for solids/semi-solids, volume for liquids, length for linear measure, number (N or U) for count.

document: Net Quantity Determination and Prohibition of Misleading Terms. Net quantity excludes wrappers/packaging. Declaration must not contain exaggerated or misleading words like "minimum", "not less than", "average", "about", or "approximately". Mass for solids/semi-solids, volume for liquids, length for linear measure, number (N or U) for count. Citation: Rule 11, Rule 12(6)

metadata.requirement_name: Mandatory International System of Units (SI) and Count Symbols (N/U)
metadata.explanation: Only International System of Units (SI) permitted. Quantity < 1 kg in grams (g); < 1 metre in centimetres (cm); < 1 litre in millilitres (ml). Quantity >= 1 kg in kilograms (kg); >= 1 litre in litres (l or L). For items sold by number, symbol must be N or U. Words like dozen, score, gross, great gross are strictly prohibited.

document: Mandatory International System of Units (SI) and Count Symbols (N/U). Only International System of Units (SI) permitted. Quantity < 1 kg in grams (g); < 1 metre in centimetres (cm); < 1 litre in millilitres (ml). Quantity >= 1 kg in kilograms (kg); >= 1 litre in litres (l or L). For items sold by number, symbol must be N or U. Words like dozen, score, gross, great gross are strictly prohibited. Citation: Rule 13(1), 13(2), 13(3), 13(4), 13(5)

metadata.requirement_name: Declarations on Textiles, Foil, Facial Tissues, and Container Commodities
metadata.explanation: Bed-sheets, fabric, sarees, towels must declare number of pieces, finished size dimensions, and price per piece. Aluminum foil, facial tissues, toilet paper must declare number of usable sheets and dimensions of each sheet. Bags, boxes, and cups must state number of containers and linear dimensions.

document: Declarations on Textiles, Foil, Facial Tissues, and Container Commodities. Bed-sheets, fabric, sarees, towels must declare number of pieces, finished size dimensions, and price per piece. Aluminum foil, facial tissues, toilet paper must declare number of usable sheets and dimensions of each sheet. Bags, boxes, and cups must state number of containers and linear dimensions. Citation: Rule 14, Rule 16, Rule 17

metadata.requirement_name: No Sale Above MRP, Tax Revision Notifications, and Class III Weighing Machine with Receipt
metadata.explanation: No retailer or dealer may sell any packaged commodity above MRP. When taxes are revised, manufacturers must issue newspaper advertisements. No person may obliterate or alter MRP. Under Rule 18(7), retailers covered under VAT/turnover tax selling by weight/volume must maintain an electronic weighing machine of at least accuracy class III (1g division) with receipt printing facility for free consumer verification.

document: No Sale Above MRP, Tax Revision Notifications, and Class III Weighing Machine with Receipt. No retailer or dealer may sell any packaged commodity above MRP. When taxes are revised, manufacturers must issue newspaper advertisements. No person may obliterate or alter MRP. Under Rule 18(7), retailers covered under VAT/turnover tax selling by weight/volume must maintain an electronic weighing machine of at least accuracy class III (1g division) with receipt printing facility for free consumer verification. Citation: Rule 18(1), 18(2), 18(3), 18(5), 18(7)

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 19, 20 & Fifth/Sixth Schedule
metadata.requirement_name: Inspection Procedure, Sample Lot Testing, and 5 Representative Samples Seizure
metadata.explanation: Legal Metrology Officers inspect manufacturer/packer premises by drawing random samples under Fifth Schedule (Lot < 4000: sample 32; Lot > 4000: sample 80). Average net quantity must equal or exceed declared quantity, and no package may exceed Maximum Permissible Error (MPE). For non-compliance, officer seizes 5 representative samples as evidence under Rule 19(8) and initiates prosecution under Rule 20.

document: Inspection Procedure, Sample Lot Testing, and 5 Representative Samples Seizure. Legal Metrology Officers inspect manufacturer/packer premises by drawing random samples under Fifth Schedule (Lot < 4000: sample 32; Lot > 4000: sample 80). Average net quantity must equal or exceed declared quantity, and no package may exceed Maximum Permissible Error (MPE). For non-compliance, officer seizes 5 representative samples as evidence under Rule 19(8) and initiates prosecution under Rule 20. Citation: Rule 19, Rule 20, Fifth Schedule

metadata.requirement_name: Inspection and Seizure at Wholesale or Retail Dealer Premises
metadata.explanation: Tests at retail/wholesale premises are carried out upon consumer complaint, suspicion of tampering/leakage, or missing declarations. If error in deficiency exceeds Maximum Permissible Error (MPE), officer seizes package and initiates action under the Act. Legend "when packed" provides safe harbor for environmental moisture loss if verified.

document: Inspection and Seizure at Wholesale or Retail Dealer Premises. Tests at retail/wholesale premises are carried out upon consumer complaint, suspicion of tampering/leakage, or missing declarations. If error in deficiency exceeds Maximum Permissible Error (MPE), officer seizes package and initiates action under the Act. Legend "when packed" provides safe harbor for environmental moisture loss if verified. Citation: Rule 21(1), 21(2), 21(3), 21(5)

metadata.requirement_name: Repacking and Seizure of Deceptive Packages
metadata.explanation: A "deceptive package" deliberately gives consumers an exaggerated or misleading impression of commodity quantity, unless larger dimensions are justified for product protection or machine filling. Officer orders repacking/relableing; failure leads to seizure and prosecution.

document: Repacking and Seizure of Deceptive Packages. A "deceptive package" deliberately gives consumers an exaggerated or misleading impression of commodity quantity, unless larger dimensions are justified for product protection or machine filling. Officer orders repacking/relableing; failure leads to seizure and prosecution. Citation: Rule 23(1), 23(2) & Explanation

metadata.requirement_name: Exemptions for Packages <=10g/10ml, Fast Food, DPCO Formulations, Bulk Produce >50kg
metadata.explanation: The 2011 Rules do not apply to: (a) packages with net weight or measure of 10g or 10ml or less; (b) fast food items packed by restaurants or hotels; (c) scheduled and non-scheduled drug formulations covered under Drugs (Price Control) Order 1995; (d) agricultural farm produce in packages exceeding 50 kg.

document: Exemptions for Packages <=10g/10ml, Fast Food, DPCO Formulations, Bulk Produce >50kg. The 2011 Rules do not apply to: (a) packages with net weight or measure of 10g or 10ml or less; (b) fast food items packed by restaurants or hotels; (c) scheduled and non-scheduled drug formulations covered under Drugs (Price Control) Order 1995; (d) agricultural farm produce in packages exceeding 50 kg. Citation: Rule 26(a), (b), (c), (d)

metadata.requirement_name: Mandatory Registration of Pre-packers and Importers within 90 Days
metadata.explanation: Every individual, firm, company, or corporation pre-packing or importing commodities must apply for registration of name and complete address with the Director or Controller within 90 days of commencement, accompanied by Rs. 500 fee. Registering authority grants certificate within 7 working days.

document: Mandatory Registration of Pre-packers and Importers within 90 Days. Every individual, firm, company, or corporation pre-packing or importing commodities must apply for registration of name and complete address with the Director or Controller within 90 days of commencement, accompanied by Rs. 500 fee. Registering authority grants certificate within 7 working days. Citation: Rule 27(1), 27(2), 27(4)

metadata.requirement_name: Net Quantity Declaration in Advertisements with Equal Font Size to Price
metadata.explanation: Any advertisement mentioning the retail sale price of pre-packaged commodity must declare the net quantity or number. The font size of the net quantity in the advertisement must be the same size as the retail sale price.

document: Net Quantity Declaration in Advertisements with Equal Font Size to Price. Any advertisement mentioning the retail sale price of pre-packaged commodity must declare the net quantity or number. The font size of the net quantity in the advertisement must be the same size as the retail sale price. Citation: Rule 31(1), Rule 31(2)

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 32 & Section 36/53 of the Act
metadata.requirement_name: Compounding Fine Rates (₹4,000 for Rules 27-31; ₹2,000 for General Violations)
metadata.explanation: Penalty for contravention of rules: (1) Contravention of Rules 27 to 31 (Registration & Advertisements) punishable with fine of ₹4,000; (2) Contravention of any other provision (Rule 6 declarations, MRP, Rule 7 font size, Rule 18 retail violations) punishable with fine of ₹2,000. Subsequent offenses under Section 36 cannot be compounded and require court prosecution with fines up to ₹50,000 or imprisonment.

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — First Schedule Table I
metadata.requirement_name: Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) Thresholds on Weight or Volume
metadata.explanation: First Schedule Table I - Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) on declared quantity: Up to 50g/ml: 9%; 50 to 100g/ml: 4.5g/ml; 100 to 200g/ml: 4.5%; 200 to 300g/ml: 9g/ml; 300 to 500g/ml: 3%; 500 to 1000g/ml (1kg/1L): 15g/ml; 1000 to 10000g/ml (1kg-10kg): 1.5%; 10000 to 15000g/ml: 150g/ml; More than 15000g/ml: 1.0%. Errors in deficiency exceeding these limits trigger seizure and prosecution.

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — First Schedule Table II
metadata.requirement_name: Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) for Length, Area, and Count
metadata.explanation: First Schedule Table II - Maximum Permissible Error: In units of length: 2% up to 10 metres, 1% thereafter; In units of area: 4% up to 10 sq. metres, 1% thereafter; By number / count: 2% of declared quantity.

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Third & Fourth Schedules
metadata.requirement_name: Commodities Allowed "When Packed" and Sale by Weight/Volume/Number Exceptions
metadata.explanation: Third Schedule allows "When packed" legend for: all kinds of soaps, lotions, and cream (other than milk cream). Fourth Schedule specifies sale mode exceptions: Aerosols (weight), Curd (weight), Electric cables/wire (length or weight), Fruits (number or weight), Edible oils/Vanaspati (weight or volume with equivalent mass declaration), LPG (weight), Ice cream (volume/weight), Ready-made garments (number), Sauces (weight), Cosmetics (weight or measure).

metadata.rule_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Fifth & Sixth Schedules
metadata.requirement_name: Tare Weight Determination and Working Standards Verification
metadata.explanation: Sixth Schedule Part-II: Tare weight determination. If empty tare packages are available, weight of 1 package is checked; if tare <= 3/10 of MPE, tare is valid for entire sample. If tare > 3/10 of MPE, 5 packages are weighed; if difference <= 4/10 of MPE, average tare is used. In absence of empties, packages are opened to determine net weight. Liquid volume is verified by specific gravity or calibrated volume measure.
